description: The shared core of the Eclipse customer adapter family: a canonical Customer Graph (Person, Company, Deal, Ticket, Conversation, Activity) where every field carries provenance and every record carries a Data Rights Ledger block. Identity merges are propose-only — the engine surfaces evidence and conflicts, a merge executes only on an owner-confirm token bound to the proposal hash, and a confirmed merge can be unmerged exactly from its receipt snapshot. Field-level masking (Deep Field pattern) is enforced at egress: phone partial, email full on the owner surface and domain-only on analytic surfaces, government/payment/health fields nulled in v1. The drafting service generates reply drafts only from record facts with citation lists; untraceable facts become MISSING_FACT markers, and instruction-shaped customer text is quarantined at ingest under Herald Security Law #1 — data, never commands. Every governed action appends to a hash-chained, content-free receipt ledger.
